name: 5-amino-1MQ
description: Small molecule (5-amino-1-methylquinolinium) that blocks the enzyme NNMT; not a peptide

note.text: Every study found was in mice, rats or cells, and most came from the group that developed it.

bullets: **Blocks NNMT,** an enzyme that methylates nicotinamide (vitamin B3), in lab tests
**In fat cells,** lowered 1-MNA, raised NAD+ and SAM, cut fat build-up (lab)
**In mice,** reached fat, muscle and liver after injection under the skin
**In people,** none of these effects has been measured
Mouse, rat and cell studies only

practical.pharmacokinetics: No human data; about 38% of a mouth dose absorbed in rats
practical.monitored: Mouse studies: weight, fat, blood sugar, liver
practical.sport: Not named on the 2026 list; S0 status unconfirmed

regulatory.text: Not named; class S0 may apply

references: Neelakantan et al., NNMT inhibitors in obese mice, Biochem Pharmacol, Jan 2018
Babula et al., 5-amino-1MQ in obese mice, Diabetes Obes Metab, Nov 2024
